task.subject: fix: show custom error message in prompt with hide_input=True

winning_diff:
--- a/src/click/termui.py
+++ b/src/click/termui.py
@@ -202,8 +202,19 @@
         try:
             result = value_proc(value)
         except UsageError as e:
             if hide_input:
-                echo(_("Error: The value you entered was invalid."), err=err)
+                message = e.message
+                # Built-in types format the invalid value with ``{value!r}``
+                # in the error message. Mask that representation instead of
+                # hiding the whole message so the user still gets useful
+                # feedback. If the raw value appears in the message in a way
+                # that cannot be masked reliably, fall back to a generic
+                # message to avoid leaking the hidden input.
+                if repr(value) in message:
+                    message = message.replace(repr(value), "'***'")
+                elif value and value in message:
+                    message = _("The value you entered was invalid.")
+                echo(_("Error: {message}").format(message=message), err=err)
             else:
                 echo(_("Error: {e.message}").format(e=e), err=err)
             continue
